description: Splits a Yjs update (base64) into com.matchahoneylatte.docs.update frame contents: one update frame up to 16384 bytes, otherwise one chunk frame per 16384 bytes followed by a commit. error too_large for an empty update or more than 256 chunks.

cases.name: a small update is one update frame
exactly 16384 bytes is still one frame
16385 bytes are two chunks and a commit
the catalog document uses the same frames
an empty update cannot be sent
